person_confirms: Every extracted event is a proposal: pre-filled for one-click confirmation or flagged as needing editing. A person confirms every event.

primary.slice: heldout: notes with at least one pathway fact in a held-out phrasing (number words 7-12 or 'toissapäivänä') and no vague fact
primary.test: exact two-sided McNemar test on paired note-level exact match
primary.success: B - A' >= 0.10 (10 points) with McNemar p < 0.01 on the heldout slice, AND B >= 0.85 exact match on the standard slice
primary.if_A_prime_wins: the headline is: a careful Finnish rule beats the learned reader on these phrasings
primary.source: NVIDIA_OPTIONS.md section 3.2, step 8 (success criteria written before the set existed)

preregistration.hash_note: no sha256 of this file was recorded at its freeze; step 8 pinned it at 23:42 UTC, before any system read a stress note

systems.A: Gemma 3 270M absolute format (A-270m-abs, MLX) + frozen resolver arm A (digits only)
systems.A': the same generation + frozen resolver arm A' (digits + Finnish lexicon fi-relative-lexicon-v1)
systems.B: Gemma 3 270M expression format, augmented (B-270m-expr-aug, MLX); code computes dates
systems.C: Gemma 3 1B expression format, augmented (C-1b-expr-aug, MLX); code computes dates
systems.v2data: for reference, not preregistered: the earlier product adapter C-270m-all-v2data (Gemma 3 270M, absolute format, CUDA greedy outputs stored in data/scribe/v3/student) + frozen resolver arm A'; validation and test only
systems.nemotron: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL reader v3 (Lane B, selected on validation); same model wrote the stress notes, so its stress score is optimistic

test.role: 700 notes read once by each Gemma arm here; the set was read in earlier work, so post hoc / confirmatory

stress.role: frozen stress set, primary, read once by each system

not_scored.v2data: not run on this set (not in the preregistration)

primary_result.comparison: B against A' on the stress held-out slice (exact McNemar, two-sided)
primary_result.criterion: B - A' >= 0.10 (10 points) with McNemar p < 0.01 on the heldout slice, AND B >= 0.85 exact match on the standard slice
primary_result.headline: the preregistered success criterion for B is not met

cascade.leak_guard: scribe/v3/cascade.py assert_validation_only() runs inside select_threshold(); every test and stress id is passed as forbidden
cascade.rule: A note is pre-filled for one-click confirmation only when the code-resolved Gemma answer and the Nemotron v3 answer agree exactly (and, for the threshold signals, its score is at or above the validation threshold). Otherwise it needs editing. A person confirms every note.
cascade.selection_rule: largest validation coverage among agreement-gated configurations with validation error <= 5% and >= 20 accepted notes; ties: agreement alone first, then the 270M model
cascade.gemma_answers: batched MLX outputs (scribe/v4/binfer.py) on validation, test and stress, so thresholds and scores come from one engine

baseline_today.source: Jev scores of the earlier student at a 5% validation error target (NVIDIA_OPTIONS.md section 1.4; scribe/TEACHING.md)
